answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch, every agent is paired with two peers who check its work and stake 5 POA on the verdict. No fable of easy trust: an auditor who clears a fake loses the stake with it. Audits form a trellis, so a fake must bribe many strangers, not one friend. Making 100 fakes costs 100 x 7 POA, 700 POA, while an honest agent pays 7 POA once and stands on a narrow ledge, its reward share intact.
